snippet.title: SM64: Dark Matter (Release Trailer)
snippet.description:
Download bps: mediafire.com/file/bfmxli8czd2yikq/SM64+Dark+Matter+v1.2.zip/file
Play on Romhacking.com: https://romhacking.com/hack/sm64-dark-matter
Music credits: https://pastebin.com/2CJaFvEX 

SM64: Dark Matter is a major SM64 rom hack with 80 stars to collect in brand new worlds. Traditional progression style and medium-to-hard (casual) difficulty.

Music used in the trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EpjuaF7veDw
Pollyanna (I Believe In You) - MOTHER Encore OST
Composer: Keiichi Suzuki & Hirokazu Tanaka
Arrangement: CopperTheJackal (https://x.com/fadingallaway)
